    Generate Predictions from a dlnmLPS Model

    pred_crossbasis.Rd

    This function generates predictions from a fitted dlnmLPS model over a specified grid of exposure and lag values. Predictions are computed relative to a user-defined reference (centering) value.

    pred_crossbasis(
  basis,
  model,
  at_x,
  at_y = NULL,
  cen,
  lag = NULL,
  by.lag = 1,
  CI.all = FALSE,
  CI = FALSE,
  ci.level = 0.95,
  exc.prob = FALSE,
  threshold = 0,
  mode = NULL,
  by = NULL
)

    Arguments

    basis

    An object of class "crossbasis" or "joint.crossbasis" defining the exposure-lag basis used in the model.

    model

    An object of class "dlnmLPS" returned by the dlnmLPS function.

    at_x

    A numeric vector specifying constant exposure values over the selected lag period, or a matrix specifying exposure histories over the same lag period used during model estimation.

    at_y

    A numeric vector or matrix analogous to at_x, specifying values or histories for the second exposure when basis is of class "joint.crossbasis".

    cen

    A value (or a vector of length 2 for "joint.crossbasis") specifying the centering (reference) exposure level used for calculating relative risk predictions.

    lag

    Either an integer scalar specifying the maximum lag, or a vector of length two specifying the lag range over which predictions are generated.

    by.lag

    Numeric value specifying the increment between consecutive lag values used for prediction.

    CI.all

    Logical value indicating whether credible intervals should be calculated only for the overall cumulative relative risk. Defaults to FALSE.

    CI

    Logical value indicating whether credible intervals should be calculated for both individual lag-specific predictions and overall cumulative relative risks. Defaults to FALSE.

    ci.level

    Numeric value specifying the credible interval level.

    exc.prob

    Logical value indicating whether exceedance probabilities should be calculated. Defaults to FALSE.

    threshold

    Numeric value defining the threshold used for exceedance probability calculations (at scale of linear predictor). Defaults to 0.

    mode

    Optional user-specified posterior mode.

    by

    Level or value of the by variable at which the DLNM relationship is evaluated. For a continuous by variable, this is a (vector of) numeric value(s) defining the level at which the effect is evaluated. For a factor by variable, this is a (vector of) factor level(s) defining the corresponding stratum.

    Value

    An object of class "dlnmLPS_pred" containing the following components (structured by value of the by-variable, if specified):

    matfit

    Matrix of predictions for the specified combinations of exposure and lag values.

    Qlower_matfit

    Matrix of lower credible interval bounds for the values in matfit.

    Qupper_matfit

    Matrix of upper credible interval bounds for the values in matfit.

    matRRfit

    Matrix of exponentiated associations from matfit.

    Qlower_matRRfit

    Matrix of exponentiated bounds from Qlower_matfit.

    Qupper_matRRfit

    Matrix of exponentiated bounds from Qupper_matfit.

    allfit

    Vector of estimated overall cumulative predictions.

    Qlower_allfit

    Vector of lower credible interval bounds for the overall cumulative predictions in allfit.

    Qupper_allfit

    Vector of upper credible interval bounds for the overall cumulative predictions in allfit.

    allRRfit

    Matrix of exponentiated associations from allfit.

    Qlower_allRRfit

    Matrix of exponentiated bounds from Qlower_allfit.

    Qupper_allRRfit

    Matrix of exponentiated bounds from Qupper_allfit.

    exc_prob_matfit

    Matrix of exceedance probabilities for matfit, if requested.

    exc_prob_allfit

    Vector of exceedance probabilities for allfit, if requested.

    Examples

    data(barcelona_temp)
data(shapefile_bcn)

# Examples of applications

dataset <- barcelona_temp |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dow = weekdays(date),
    year = lubridate::year(date),
    month = lubridate::month(date)
  )

group <- factor(paste0(dataset$District, "-", dataset$year))


### Example 1: Penalized and common DLNM

# Create the (penalized) crossbasis
basis.max <- dlnm::crossbasis(
    dataset$Tmax,
    argvar = list(df = 5, fun = "ps"),
    arglag = list(df = 5, fun = "ps"),
    lag = 14,
    group = group
)

# Fit model
model_max_common <- dlnmLPS(
    dtot ~ 1 + factor(dow) +
    sm(month, arg = list(type = "ns", df = 3)) +
    sm(year, arg = list(type = "rw1")) +
    sm(basis.max, arg = list(pen= 2)) +
    sm(District, arg = list(type = "Leroux", map = shapefile_bcn)),
    data = dataset,
    offset = log(pop),
    model.comparison = list(DIC = TRUE),
    family = "Poisson"
)

# Make predictions
pred_max <- pred_crossbasis(
     basis = basis.max,
     model = model_max_common,
     at_x = 22:30,
     cen = 25,
     lag = c(0,14),
     CI = TRUE
)

# Plot results (lag-specific and overall RR)
plot(pred_max, slice_lag = c(0,3,8), ptype = "slices", CI = TRUE, xlab = "temp", ylab = "RR")

plot(pred_max, ptype = "overall", CI = TRUE, xlab = "temp", ylab = "RR")



### Example 2: Penalized and common joint DLNM

# Create the (penalized) joint crossbasis
basis.max_min <- joint.crossbasis(
    cbind(dataset$Tmax, dataset$Tmin),
    argvar1 = list(df = 5, fun = "ps"),
    argvar2 = list(df = 5, fun = "ps"),
    arglag = list(df = 5, fun = "ps"),
    lag = 14,
    group = group
)

# Fit model
model_joint_common <- dlnmLPS(
    dtot ~ 1 + factor(dow) +
    sm(month, arg = list(type = "ns", df = 3)) +
    sm(year, arg = list(type = "rw1")) +
    sm(basis.max_min, arg = list(pen= 2)) +
    sm(District, arg = list(type = "Leroux", map = shapefile_bcn)),
    data = dataset,
    offset = log(pop),
    model.comparison = list(DIC = TRUE),
    family = "Poisson"
)

# Make predictions
pred_max_min <- pred_crossbasis(
     basis = basis.max_min,
     model = model_joint_common,
     at_x = c(29,29,29,30,30,30,31,31,31),
     at_y = c(20,21,22,20,21,22,20,21,22),
     cen = c(25,15),
     lag = c(0,14),
     CI = TRUE
)

# Plot results (contour plot overall RR)
contour(pred_max_min, ptype = "overall", cols = function(n) hcl.colors(n, "Inferno"))



### Example 3: Unpenalized and spatially varying DLNM

# Create the (unpenalized) crossbasis
knots_max <- quantile(dataset$Tmax, probs = c(0.10,0.50,0.90))
knots_lag <- dlnm::logknots(0:14, nk = 2)

basis.max_unpen <- dlnm::crossbasis(
    dataset$Tmax,
    argvar=list(fun = "ns", knots = knots_max),
    arglag=list(fun="ns", knots = knots_lag),
    lag=14,
    group=group
)

# Fit model
model_max_spat <- dlnmLPS(
    dtot ~ 1 + factor(dow) +
    sm(month, arg = list(type = "ns", df = 3)) +
    sm(year, arg = list(type = "rw1")) +
    sm(basis.max_unpen, by = District,
            arg.by = list(type = "Leroux", map = shapefile_bcn)) +
    sm(District, arg = list(type = "Leroux", map = shapefile_bcn)),
    data = dataset,
    offset = log(pop),
    model.comparison = list(DIC = TRUE),
    family = "Poisson")

summary(model_max_spat)

# Make predictions
pred_spat_max <- pred_crossbasis(
    basis.max_unpen,
    model_max_spat,
    at_x = 22:30,
    cen = 25,
    lag = c(0,14),
    CI = TRUE,
    by = unique(dataset$District)
)

# Plot results (region-specific overal RR)
plot(pred_spat_max, ptype = "overall", CI = FALSE, xlab = "temp", ylab = "RR", ylim = c(0.9,3.0),
    multiple.plots = FALSE)



### Example 4: Unpenalized and deprivation-varying DLNM

# Fit model
model_max_conf <- dlnmLPS(
    dtot ~ 1 + factor(dow) +
    sm(month, arg = list(type = "ns", df = 3)) +
    sm(year, arg = list(type = "rw1")) +
    sm(depriv, arg = list(type = "ns", df = 3)) +
    sm(basis.max_unpen, by = depriv,
            arg.by = list(type = "ns", df = 3)) +
    sm(District, arg = list(type = "Leroux", map = shapefile_bcn)),
    data = dataset,
    offset = log(pop),
    model.comparison = list(DIC = TRUE),
    family = "Poisson")

# Make predictions
pred_conf_max <- pred_crossbasis(
    basis.max_unpen,
    model_max_conf,
    at_x = 22:30,
    cen = 25,
    lag = c(0,14),
    CI = TRUE,
    by = quantile(dataset$depriv,probs= c(0.10, 0.90))
)

# Extract overall RR for 28 and 30 degrees Celsius for both deprivation indices
extract_predictions(
    pred_conf_max,
    slice_x = c(28,30),
    ptype = "allRRfit"
)
#>    x      fit    lower    upper                 by
#> 1 28 1.236969 1.148188 1.332615 -0.929699483475094
#> 2 30 1.435580 1.158489 1.778947 -0.929699483475094
#> 3 28 1.217482 1.132780 1.308517   1.21474771640633
#> 4 30 1.620977 1.462298 1.796875   1.21474771640633

# Extract lag-specific RR for 28 and 30 degrees Celsius, lag 0 and 8 and
# for 10% deprivation percentile
extract_predictions(
    pred_conf_max,
    slice_x = c(28,30),
    slice_lag = c(0,8),
    slice_by = quantile(dataset$depriv,probs= c(0.10)),
    ptype = "matRRfit"
)
#>    x lag       fit     lower    upper                 by
#> 1 28   0 1.0840473 1.0422849 1.127483 -0.929699483475094
#> 2 30   0 1.2925594 1.1909441 1.402845 -0.929699483475094
#> 3 28   8 1.0175714 1.0054077 1.029882 -0.929699483475094
#> 4 30   8 0.9985843 0.9716919 1.026221 -0.929699483475094

# Plot results (contour plot exposure-lag-response)
contour(pred_conf_max, ptype = "cross", cols = function(n) hcl.colors(n, "Inferno"))
